QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). Both backends are also off: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the shipped config leaves MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and its backends undefined, so no mutex is compiled in by default. That covers a default build defining neither of the two threading macros the item refers to (taken here as THREADING_PTHREAD and THREADING_ALT).
